predictions.note: Refined split-screen of two editorial images with monospace UI and HUD details; striking and polished, but the first screen gives little context.

Bold dark hero with a striking chef-stag logo and floating fruit; strong mood, but the first screen has no navigation or clear next step.
Clean, confident hero with a playful 3D keychain and tight tight headline type; strong polish, though the lower half is empty and the message is simple.
Elegant gold-on-grey Capitolium splash with refined serif and script pairing, but sparse and loader-like, so little to judge yet.
